description: Portfolio add-on grants (Wave P PY2.4, contract 5.4): each add-on month includes one Menivor launch reel and a Rally mail allowance. Rago holds the monthly balance; the partner debits it with transaction_id <aud>:grant:<org>:<YYYY-MM>:<n> and refuses a debit beyond it. Allowances come from Scribase config/plans.json addons.portfolio.grants (menivor_launch_reel 1, rally_mail 500).

billable_metrics.name: Add-on launch reel used
billable_metrics.description: One event per launch reel Menivor renders against the monthly grant.

billable_metrics.name: Add-on mail sent
billable_metrics.description: One event per email Rally sends against the monthly mail allowance.

plans.name: Portfolio add-on grants
plans.description: A $0 plan: the add-on itself is billed by Scribase through Dodo. Package charges at 0.0 with the monthly grant as free units, so Rago's current usage shows the balance.
